comments.classifier_cannot_go_red: the classifier failed its own red sample: it no longer recognises a docstring with a temporal marker -- refusing to certify an empty result as a pass
comments.classify_empty_scope: classify: no over-long docstrings in scope (zero-value guard: this is a measured state, not a broken classifier)
comments.classify_scanned_nothing: the classifier found zero functions -- `zreflect/` is missing or unreadable; an empty classification is not a pass
comments.docstring_in_strict_mode: %(file)s:%(line)d `%(name)s` carries a docstring, and this repo declares `strict`: a function must be legible from its signature and body
comments.docstring_wider_than_interface: %(file)s:%(line)d `%(name)s` explains itself in %(chars)d characters over %(body)d code lines -- that is design rationale, not a calling contract; it belongs in HISTORY.md
comments.off: REFLECT_COMMENTS is unset => this repo has not declared whether a comment is a claim or a crutch; stating that and standing down
comments.ok: comment mode %(mode)s: %(files)d files scanned, %(count)d docstrings in scope
comments.title: Comment discipline
knobs.sem.reflect_comments: comment discipline: `strict` (no docstrings at all) / `mismatch` (no docstring >= 500 chars over <= 20 code lines) / empty = off
